# design-image-studio

💳 Paid API required. Curated by Skill Harbor: this skill turns a loose creative brief into design-quality AI images instead of generic AI art. It keeps a full design-system prompt as the reasoning layer (purpose, audience, channel, visual system, hierarchy, anti-filler and anti-slop rules), compiles it into a compact brief, then into the shortest useful image prompt. It routes each request to a task workflow (poster, product, PPT, infographic, teaching diagram), ships a Python wrapper (scripts/design_image.py) that generates directly via Volcengine's Seedream models, and offers a prompt-only mode that just prints the design reasoning, the compiled brief, and the final prompt. By @kangarooking, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via github.com/topics/ai-skills. Honest caveats: generation needs a Volcengine API key, a paid image-generation service billed per image; image models still struggle with dense, tiny text, and the skill itself warns against pixel-accurate UI recreation or precise text rendering; the repo includes a few Chinese examples. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
